effort.label: Effort only
effort.description: Most risk removed for the work involved. Cost is shown but not counted.

cost.label: Effort + cost
cost.description: Cost counts as extra effort, so a free fix beats a paid one that does the same good. Essential recovery fixes are exempt from the cost penalty.
cost.formula: risk reduction ÷ (effort + cost weight × cost points)

essential.description: A fix is essential when it resolves a CIS Implementation Group 1 safeguard in one of these recovery and response controls. Essential fixes skip the cost penalty and are scheduled no later than latestTimeframe days.

cisControls.11: Lets you recover your data after ransomware or a failure, without paying.
cisControls.17: Limits the damage and downtime when an attack gets through.
